tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Check right now whether a website/URL is up: HTTP status, response time (ms) from Cloudflare's edge, redirect chain and final URL, content type/size, server header, and which security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) are present or mis

tools.name: check_websites
tools.description: Check up to 10 URLs in parallel and get up/down, HTTP status and response time for each. Free, no key.

tools.name: start_uptime_monitor
tools.description: Monitor up to 3 URLs every ~5 minutes and send DOWN/UP alerts to a Slack or Discord webhook or a Telegram bot, plus a public status page. Free 7-day trial, no signup. UpLane Pro: 50 URLs, 7 USDC/month (key UP-... from https://uplane.deanhiki.workers.dev/#pro).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_website, check_websites · Public sink: start_uptime_monitor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_website, check_websites · Public sink: start_uptime_monitor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
